//: Dead-code audit config. Extends the base tsconfig and turns ON the two
unused-symbol checks that tsconfig.json deliberately leaves off.
Why this is a separate file rather than a flag in tsconfig.json:
with the flags on, `npm run build` fails on 28 findings today. D-06 in
docs/SYSTEM_DESIGN.md is explicit that pass 1 must NOT block work -
only make the inventory visible - and pass 2 deletes.
Usage:  npm run audit:unused        (lists the findings)
Delete a finding, re-run, watch the count fall. When it reaches 0,
move noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters into tsconfig.json for real.
The include list deliberately excludes **/*.test.ts: fixtures and
local helpers in tests are not production dead code.
